verdict.rationale: Orb documents managed daily exports of resource types to a destination of the user's choice, plus revenue exports for financial systems. This gives a first-party path to get billing data out, but the pack does not say which resource types are covered. Nothing in the evidence addresses porting stored payment methods to another provider, and the migration guide only covers moving into Orb from Stripe. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that subscriptions, invoices and raw usage events are all exportable; any payment-method portability or export capability; independent or hands-on corroboration of a full exit export.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can export every subscription, invoice, and usage record — and port stored payment methods out to another provider — if I choose to leave

citations.quote: Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
